import numpy as np

# Germany invaded Poland on September 1, 1939

print(f"Day of Germany invading Poland in September 1939: {day_of_invasion}")

# Divide projected value by day number
result = y_projected / day_of_invasion
print(f"Result (projected value / day): {result}")

# Round to nearest whole number
result_rounded = round(result)
print(f"Rounded result: {result_rounded}")
